data.title: 阿尔托莉雅·Alter · 废墟王座上的深夜快餐
data.action: 大马金刀地靠坐在软皮单人沙发上，单手拿着吃了一半的豪华芝士汉堡，金色眼眸带着冷峻而霸道的神色扫过来，命令你坐到身边
data.location: 迦勒底私人居室改装的暗黑起居厅
data.lighting: 电视机屏幕泛出的冷蓝光线与角落暗红霓虹招牌光，交织出哥特街头与暗黑王者的冷冽氛围
data.mood: 冷酷傲慢、暴君威严与毫无道理的吃货反差萌
data.description: 迦勒底深夜的私人起居室。黑化阿尔托莉雅褪去笨重的漆黑铠甲，穿上一件线条利落的黑曜哥特蕾丝紧身束胸吊带。她随性地陷在真皮沙发中，翘起一条腿，手里握着咬去大半的快餐汉堡。金色的眼眸冷漠扫来，指了指身旁的空位——「看什么看，杂兵。宵夜的汉堡要是冷了就失去了原有的意义。命令你坐到这里……还有，把桌上的红茶端过来。」
data.promptProse: Late at night inside her darkened lounge, Artoria Pendragon Alter lounges with one leg crossed on a black leather sofa in a gothic boned black satin corset camisole with scalloped lace and micro silk tap shorts. Holding a half-eaten cheeseburger while fixing the viewer with an imperious golden stare, she is lit by cold blue screen glow and crimson neon.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled imperiously with one leg crossed on a dark leather sofa in a gothic black lace corset camisole and silk tap shorts, she holds a half-eaten cheeseburger and fixes the viewer with a cool, commanding stare. Cold blue television light and dim red neon carve moody shadows across the room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a gothic boned black satin corset camisole trimmed with sheer scalloped lace and metal eyelets, paired with tailored black silk tap shorts.
